raw:

  relation "arrive"
  role subject "all the parcels"
  role source "the Zara order"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "claim for"
    role subject "the user"
    role object "all the parcels"
    polarity affirmed
  end
